name: Space radiation
description: Ionizing radiation from galactic cosmic rays, solar particle events and trapped radiation. Invisible to the senses; requires dosimetry and environmental monitoring to detect.
monitoring_role: Only dosimeters and radiation area monitors measure exposure. Ordinary physiological sensors (heart rate, blood pressure) cannot measure radiation exposure.

name: Isolation and confinement
description: Long periods in small, confined volumes with a small crew and limited contact with family and support systems can affect behavioral health, sleep, team dynamics, workload and fatigue.
monitoring_role: Self-reported mood, stress, fatigue, workload and connectedness; sleep records; optional cognitive assessments; private medical communication.

name: Distance from Earth
description: Increasing distance delays or interrupts communication and makes resupply, evacuation and real-time medical support from Earth difficult or impossible; crews must operate more independently.
monitoring_role: Onboard assessment, local alerting, preloaded procedures, store-and-forward medical reports and synchronization when the Earth link is available.

name: Gravity fields
description: Microgravity, partial gravity (Moon ≈ 1/6 g, Mars ≈ 3/8 g) and transitions between gravity fields require adaptation of muscles, bones, inner ear, cardiovascular system and fluid distribution.
monitoring_role: Cardiovascular vital signs, exercise and physical performance records, sensorimotor/balance assessments, vision symptoms and clinician eye examinations, specialized bone assessments when available.

name: Hostile and closed environments
description: The vehicle or habitat is a closed ecosystem: atmosphere (CO2, oxygen, pressure), temperature, humidity, contaminants, water and food supply, noise, lighting and microbial communities must be controlled.
monitoring_role: Environmental sensors (CO2, O2, temperature, humidity, air quality) recorded separately from medical measurements; nutrition and hydration records; illness symptoms and laboratory results.
